summary: The move to Microsoft's sign-in is safer, and every install is checked against one standard.

fixes.title: A safer move to Microsoft's sign-in
fixes.text: The update now prepares the web app before it turns Microsoft's sign-in on, and waits while Azure is still busy with the app. A move that cannot finish leaves the earlier sign-in working.

fixes.title: Every install checked against one standard
fixes.text: Each update run now checks that the web app is set up exactly as the standard says, and lists anything the earlier sign-in left behind. It only reports; nothing is removed.
